text: Probably far more than I should. I check it first thing in the morning and it's usually the last thing I look at before I go to sleep. I use it for pretty much everything, from messaging and banking to reading the news and listening to podcasts.

tips.en: Far more than I should — humour and self-criticism sound natural.
tips.kk: Far more than I should — әзілі мен өзін-өзі сынауы бар жауап табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Far more than I should — ответ с юмором и самокритикой звучит естественно.
tips.example: Probably far more than I should

tips.en: Listing with from… to… instead of a plain list.
tips.kk: Жай тізімнің орнына from… to… арқылы тізу.
tips.ru: Перечисление через from… to… вместо простого списка.
tips.example: from messaging and banking to reading the news

questions.followUp: What do you use it for most?
questions.question: How often do you use your mobile phone?

text: It was a very basic model my parents gave me when I was about ten, mainly so they could call me after school. It could only make calls and send text messages, and the battery lasted for days. Compared to my smartphone now, it seems almost prehistoric.

tips.en: What it was, why and what it could do — a complete answer about the past.
tips.kk: Не болды, не үшін және не істей алды — өткен туралы толық жауап.
tips.ru: Что было, зачем и что умел — полный ответ о прошлом.
tips.example: mainly so they could call me after school

tips.en: The comparison with today’s phone ends the answer vividly.
tips.kk: Бүгінгі телефонмен салыстыру жауапты жарқын аяқтайды.
tips.ru: Сравнение с сегодняшним телефоном завершает ответ ярко.

questions.followUp: How old were you when you got it?
questions.question: What was your first mobile phone like?

text: I usually prefer sending messages, because I can reply when it's convenient and think about what I want to say. That said, if something is urgent or a bit complicated, I'd rather just call, since explaining things in writing can take ages.

tips.en: A preference plus the case when it changes — a mature answer.
tips.kk: Таңдау және ол өзгеретін жағдай — парасатты жауап.
tips.ru: Предпочтение и случай, когда выбор меняется, — зрелый ответ.
tips.example: if something is urgent or a bit complicated, I'd rather just call

tips.en: Because, that said and since — three different linkers in a short answer.
tips.kk: Because, that said, since — қысқа жауапта үш түрлі байланыстырушы.
tips.ru: Because, that said, since — три разных связки в коротком ответе.

note.en: An idiom: take a very long time.

questions.question: Do you prefer calling people or sending messages?

text: Not completely off, but I put it on silent when I'm studying or at the cinema. I've also started leaving it in another room for an hour before bed, because I read somewhere that it helps you sleep better, and I think it's actually working.

tips.en: Not completely off, but is more precise than a simple “no”.
tips.kk: Not completely off, but — жай «жоқ» дегеннен дәлірек.
tips.ru: Not completely off, but — точнее, чем просто «нет».

title.en: A precise answer, not yes / no

tips.example: Not completely off, but I put it on silent

tips.en: Present perfect for a recent change and its result.
tips.kk: Жақындағы өзгеріс пен оның нәтижесіне present perfect.
tips.ru: Present perfect для недавней перемены и её результат.
tips.example: I've also started leaving it in another room

note.en: Stresses that there is a real result.

questions.question: Are there times when you turn your phone off?

text: I think it depends on the age. For younger children, a simple phone for emergencies makes sense, especially if they travel to school alone. But I'm not sure primary school children need a smartphone, because it's so easy for them to spend hours on games and social media.

tips.en: The answer separates cases instead of one general yes or no.
tips.kk: Жауап бір жалпы «иә» не «жоқ» бермей, жағдайларды бөледі.
tips.ru: Ответ разделяет случаи, а не даёт одно общее «да» или «нет».
tips.example: a simple phone for emergencies makes sense

tips.en: I’m not sure is a soft way to express doubt.
tips.kk: I’m not sure — күмәнді жұмсақ білдіру тәсілі.
tips.ru: I’m not sure — мягкий способ выразить сомнение.
tips.example: I'm not sure primary school children need a smartphone

note.kk: Бұл әсіресе қашан маңызды екенін нақтылайды.

questions.question: Do you think children should have mobile phones?
